excerpt.zh: 巡游舰正在举办一场围绕该星系恒星的穿梭机比赛。乘客们纷纷下注，挤满了每一个舷窗。
excerpt.en: The cruise is hosting a shuttle race around this system's star. Passengers are placing bets and crowding every viewport.
